title.narrative: Silwan Tobdi3 - Silwan Arts School: Reinforcing Palestinian Culture, Preserving Identity

description.narrative:
The project supports the creative capacity, wellbeing and resilience of the community in Silwan and Jerusalem through arts and culture. It enhances the accessibility of around 1,200 children and youth to innovative learning spaces through art education and enables 12,500 people to participate in cultural life. In addition, it builds the capacities of 130 art teachers in art education and teaching arts to children with disabilities, and improves the learning environment of the Silwan Art School through enhancing its infrastructure and expanding bank of instruments and equipment.
This intervention from 2022-2025 to support Silwan Music School with institutional and capacity development. This project would provide an opportunity to children and youth who lives in less privileged areas with low living standers and income to have access to Music education. - Improving the Schools’ art education programs and include new marginalised communities such as: Al-Issawiya, Al-Izzariyeh. - Building local capacities in art education and teaching arts to children with disabilities, especially young art practitioners and teachers. - Enhancing the learning environment of the Silwan Art School by providing for infrastructure development and expanding its instruments’ bank and equipment. - Strengthening the JYCF partnerships with local and international stakeholders. - Providing support to government school’s in art education through strengthening the sustainability of its academic programs and enhance its existing capacities.
